# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this package, please **do not** open a public GitHub issue.

Instead, report it privately using one of these options:

1. **[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/codewithdennis/filament-advanced-choice/security/advisories/new)** for this repository (preferred if available), or
2. Contact the maintainer via the options shown on the [CodeWithDennis](https://github.com/CodeWithDennis) GitHub profile.

Please include enough detail to reproduce the issue. We will treat reports in confidence and aim to respond promptly.
